passive.name: Rising Spell Force
passive.description: Ezreal gains increasing Attack Speed each time he successfully hits a spell, stacking up to 5 times.

primaryAbilities.name: Mystic Shot
primaryAbilities.description: Ezreal fires a damaging bolt of energy which reduces all of his cooldowns slightly if it strikes an enemy unit.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Ezreal fires a bolt of energy, dealing <physicalDamage>{{ damage }} physical damage</physicalDamage> to the first enemy hit and reducing his Ability Cooldowns by {{ cdrefund }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Essence Flux
primaryAbilities.description: Ezreal fires an orb that sticks to the first champion or objective hit. If Ezreal hits an enemy with the orb, it detonates and deals damage.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Ezreal fires a magical orb that sticks to the first champion, structure, or epic jungle monster hit for {{ detonationtimeout }} seconds. If Ezreal hits that target with an Attack or Ability, it detonates, dealing <magicDamage>{{ damage }} magic damage</magicDamage>. Detonating with an Ability refunds the Mana cost of that Ability plus <scaleMana>{{ manareturn }} Mana</scaleMana>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Arcane Shift
primaryAbilities.description: Ezreal teleports to a target nearby location and fires a homing bolt which strikes the nearest enemy unit. Prioritizes enemies stuck with Essence Flux.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Ezreal teleports then fires a bolt at the nearest enemy, dealing <magicDamage>{{ damage }} magic damage</magicDamage>. The bolt prioritizes enemies affected by <spellName>Essence Flux</spellName>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Trueshot Barrage
primaryAbilities.description: Ezreal winds up before firing a powerful barrage of energy that deals massive damage to each unit it passes through (damage is reduced for minions and non-epic monsters).
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Ezreal fires a massive energy arc that deals <magicDamage>{{ damage }} magic damage</magicDamage>. Damage to minions and non-epic jungle monsters is reduced to <magicDamage>{{ damageminionmonster }} magic damage</magicDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}
